review_type: independent source-only review, final frozen executable sources

findings.finding: Java caller is narrowly placed after the unchanged long run scanner/tryMergeRuns admission declines, bounded to 512..8192. A false Java stub/C1/interpreter result follows the original recursion/depth/pivot code; true returns only after the whole range is sorted. No duplicate scan, adaptive path, or other primitive route was added.

The C2 intrinsic signature ([JII)Z and TypeFunc domain/result agree: nonnull array base pointer, low/high int indices, raw stack-limit pointer, BOOL result. The range guards use unsigned low<=high, high<=array_length and unsigned (size-512)<=7680 before any native pointer arithmetic. Invalid calls deopt to the Java false stub. Native validates pointer/low/order/length and stack reserve before computing array+low; Java/C2 supplies the high<=length proof.

The native entry is a non-inlined generic-ISA wrapper; only a noinline kernel is compiled for avx512f,dq,vl,avx2,popcnt. E/U invoke in-place int64 kernels on array+low, no array copy or input-sized allocation is visible in the bounded call chain. Max range is 8192 and recursion is capped at 8; forced depth-zero test TU exercises the same vendored qsort fallback without adding a product hook.

Both embedded and upstream qsort now reject partition indices outside [left,right+1] before child math, and only form pivot_index-1 for a nonempty left child (pivot_index>left); right recurses only for pivot_index<=right. Index-bounded heap fallback addresses both whole subrange and remains within count by its child/end bounds. This supports machine-level bounded indexing under value races, but does not establish C++ language-level data-race freedom; stress must not be represented as proof of it or of sorted output under race.

Optional C2 stub loading is null-safe and requires HotSpot AVX-512 SIMD sort, AVX512VL, AVX2, and POPCNT features; DSO compiles for AVX512F/DQ/VL plus AVX2/POPCNT. CPUID dependencies plus the existing HotSpot sort gate are relied on for AVX512F. Runtime flag/feature consistency, actual DSO loading, generated call behavior, and emitted ISA must still be verified on the chosen machine.

The 32 KiB carrier stack reserve is not substantiated by a built .su stack audit, compiler output, disassembly/call graph, or measured stack high-water evidence. The new stack audit script is only a checker and no results exist. Before ordinary execution, inspect actual E/U optimized stack reports and machine code, including the guarded noinline kernel transition and worst-depth fallback, then retain a successful audit receipt.

No compiled C2 graph, safepoint/GC map, register/stack ABI, native symbol, intrinsic activation, fallback, or feature-disabled evidence exists yet. Source inspection cannot establish that the raw array pointer survives the RC_LEAF call correctly or that every intended C2 flag/VM policy routes as expected.

The ordinary racy stress is only a bounded crash/termination probe with no sorted assertion. Plain Java writes concurrent with C++ reads/writes are not C++ data-race-free; it cannot prove formal race safety or correctness under concurrent mutation.
